__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

syncVersion.description: Which sync flow the site runs. Hardware-id / token clearing is only permitted for v7 sites. See issue #11784.

appName.description: Client application of the remote site (e.g. "open mSupply"). Tracked from v7 sync activity; null for sites that have not synced over v7.

appVersion.description: Remote site's application version, as last reported during v7 sync.

lastConnectionDatetime.description: Last time the remote made any authenticated v7 request.

lastSyncDatetime.description: Last time the remote fully pulled from this central server.

firstSyncDatetime.description: First time the remote completed an initialising pull.
